name: Karen
source:
While his parents leaves on a sudden business trip the protagonist, Yousuke, goes to stay at an acquintance's house. This "house" is actually an old Shinto shrine which he will manage together with the three sisters living there.

Yousuke's struggle to revive the run-down shrine begins and so does his search for love...
